[Transitioning from Academia to Industry](https://medium.com/@andy.stein/transitioning-from-academia-to-industry-57500b0fca74),
by Andy Stein on Medium, 13 February 2022.

**Most of the advice for moving from academia to industry is also advice for
living.** The post introduces a
[career guide](https://sites.google.com/site/andrewsteinphd/career-advice)
written as a pre-read for PhD students and postdocs who ask for advice, and
notes that the topics friends and colleagues suggested adding were mostly life
lessons.

- **Curiosity.** Staying open to learning, to feedback and to wonder.
- **Collaboration.** Everyone has blind spots, and working with others fills
  them.
- **Mindfulness.** In a difficult moment, pausing to choose the words and the
  action from a place of equanimity.
- **Practice carries over.** Noticing a reaction, asking where it comes from
  and then choosing how to act takes practice, a coach or a therapist can help
  build it, and a skill practised in one domain carries over to the others.
